subject: Re: M-RL kickoff — closing decisions
body:
Team,

Closing decisions for the half:

1. M-IQN ships with 2 seeds, not 3. The suite's job is to be a dependable baseline, and a week's slip past 05-25 costs us the Evalline publication slot. We annotate the seed count on the reference curves so nobody misreads the variance.
2. TF1 stays contained per Ivo's March call. A TF2/JAX port is formally out of scope for this half — I've written it into the Q3 candidate list instead, where it can compete on merit.
3. Yara publishes M-DQN reference curves (full 57 games, 3 seeds) plus the al_dqn ablation to Evalline by 05-20; M-IQN follows by 05-25.

Quentin — the 39-of-41 result is exactly the reproduction story I wanted for the readout. Nice.

Ulla
